name: floating-surface
title: Floating Surface
description: The shared floating-overlay module: one Portal/Positioner/Popup composer, the popup surface recipes, the list-item recipe, and the in-panel search row.

meta.whenToUse: Building or restyling an anchored overlay, a menu-like list, or a search row inside a panel — compose this rather than restating the plumbing.
meta.whenNotToUse: Product UI: install the overlay you actually want (Popover, DropdownMenu, Command); they already compose it.
